answer: The zephyr schedule is applied in marble and vertex exposes each instalment. Someone therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 36% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2751 identities would post 1510 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
